title: When Should a Voice Agent Speak? End-of-Turn Detection in Turkish
title_zh: 语音智能体何时该开口？土耳其语话轮结束检测
abstract_en: A voice agent that waits for a fixed silence before replying either interrupts users who pause mid-utterance or responds late to users who have finished. This study examines the decision at the onset of silence, using turn ends and turn-internal pauses extracted from the Real-TurnTurk corpus of Turkish dyadic video calls. A fine-tuned Turkish TurnGPT model, a zero-shot Turkish language model and a deployed multilingual detector are compared, together with voice-activity timing and facial features, under recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint evaluation with paired cluster bootstrap tests. On held-out recordings, the fine-tuned model separates turn ends from pauses better than both text baselines and is the best calibrated of the three. Timing features of the current speaker are similarly informative, and their combination with the fine-tuned text score gives the best timing-based results; with logistic regression, this combination also outperforms the same combination with either text baseline. In a latency simulation, adding the text score to a silence timeout shortens the mean response delay at the same interruption rate. On automatic Whisper transcripts, the fine-tuned model retains its advantage over the zero-shot model.
abstract_zh: 依赖固定静音阈值的语音智能体，可能打断只是暂时停顿的用户，也可能在用户说完后迟迟不回应。本文基于 Real-TurnTurk 土耳其语双人视频通话语料，研究如何在静音刚开始时区分话轮结束与话轮内停顿。研究比较了微调后的土耳其语 TurnGPT、以零样本方式使用的土耳其语语言模型和已部署的多语言检测器，并考察了语音活动时序和面部特征。评估分别在录音互不重叠和说话人互不重叠的设置下进行，采用配对聚类自助法（paired cluster bootstrap）检验。在留出的录音上，微调后的 TurnGPT 比另外两个基线更能区分话轮结束与话轮内停顿，概率校准也最好。当前说话人的时序特征具有相近的判别能力，与 TurnGPT 文本分数融合后，在涉及时序特征的方案中表现最佳；使用逻辑回归融合时，该组合也优于换用任一基线文本分数的组合。延迟仿真表明，在相同打断率下，将文本分数纳入静音超时策略可缩短平均响应延迟。使用 Whisper 自动转写时，微调后的 TurnGPT 仍优于零样本模型。
key_points_zh: 在静音刚开始时判断用户是说完了还是暂时停顿，而不是只等待固定时长。
在留出录音上，微调后的 TurnGPT 优于两个基线，且概率校准最好。
当前说话人的语音活动时序与文本分数互补；融合 TurnGPT 分数优于融合任一基线分数。
延迟仿真中，引入文本分数可在相同打断率下缩短平均响应延迟。
在 Whisper 自动转写上，微调后的 TurnGPT 仍优于零样本模型。
